verdict.rationale: Fireflies supports some autonomous background behavior—auto-joining calendar meetings to record/transcribe/summarize, webhook triggers on transcription completion, and Zapier integration to auto-fetch transcripts—which function as lightweight automations running without manual intervention. However there's no evidence of a dedicated agentic automation/workflow builder for chaining multi-step autonomous actions beyond these fixed triggers.  missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow engine, evidence of multi-step autonomous task chains, and independent confirmation of automations running reliably unattended.
